register.name: PCI_HDMA_DAR_HIGH_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel DAR High Register. This register holds the higher 32 bits of the Destination Address Register (DAR) of an HDMA read channel.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_WATERMARK_EN_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel Linked-list Watermark Enable Register. This register controls the watermark interrupts generated after processing a watermarked LL element. HDMA updates this field as LL elements are processed.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_CONTROL1_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel Control Settings 1 Register. This register controls the operation of the HDMA read channel.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_FUNC_NUM_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel Function Number Register. This register controls HDMA read channel to Physical/Virtual function mapping.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_QOS_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel QoS Settings Register. This register controls the HDMA read channel QoS features.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_STATUS_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel Status Register. This register specifies the current operational state of a channel.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_INT_STATUS_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel Interrupt Status Register. This register provides information regarding the HDMA read channel interrupt status.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_INT_SETUP_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel Interrupt Setup Register. This register is used to configure interrupts for a read channel.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_INT_CLEAR_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel Interrupt Clear Register. This register indicates interrupt clear status of a read channel. It is a self-clearing register. Reads to this register returns '0'.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_MSI_STOP_LOW_OFF_RDCH_2

register.name: PCI_HDMA_MSI_STOP_HIGH_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Stop Remote Interrupt Address High Register. This register holds the higher 32 bits of the Stop Interrupt MWr TLP address.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_MSI_WATERMARK_LOW_OFF_RDCH_2

register.name: PCI_HDMA_MSI_ABORT_LOW_OFF_RDCH_2

register.name: PCI_HDMA_MSI_ABORT_HIGH_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Abort Remote Interrupt Address High. This register holds the lower 32 bits of the Abort Interrupt mwr TLP address.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_MSI_MSGD_OFF_RDCH_2
register.comment: HDMA Read Channel Remote Interrupt Data Register. This register holds the IMWr TLP Data of an HDMA read channel.

register.name: PCI_HDMA_CYCLE_OFF_WRCH_3

Note: The HDMA updates this register while operating on a linked list.
